defect_summary: Follow-up to BFF-GOVERNANCE-EVIDENCE-REDACTION-SWEEP-001, whose independent reviewer recorded two out-of-contract findings: (1) the same discarded-identity pattern exists in control_loops/router.py (9 handlers call _read_identity(authorization) and discard the return value) and in core/app_factory.py's inline settings handlers (2 handlers call extract_identity(authorization) and discard it); (2) GovernanceService.committee_projection returns linked_evidence unredacted on the committee detail route despite already receiving identity as a parameter. This task audits all 9 control-loops handlers plus the 2 settings handlers plus the committee detail route, redacts every surface whose response structurally carries evidence-ref-shaped content (including canonical OODA packet audit_refs and nested stage bundles, as well as committee synthesis_summary and service_handoff evidence/audit references), and documents why the remaining surfaces carry none.

acceptance_notes.fail_closed: Confirmed by test_ooda_packet_detail_fails_closed_when_capabilities_unresolvable, test_ooda_packet_detail_fails_closed_when_capabilities_return_none, test_v5_intervention_detail_fails_closed_when_capabilities_unresolvable, test_committee_detail_fails_closed_when_capabilities_unresolvable, test_committee_real_producer_detail_fails_closed_when_capabilities_unresolvable, test_committee_real_producer_detail_fails_closed_when_capabilities_return_none, test_downstream_health_fails_closed_when_capabilities_unresolvable, test_downstream_health_fails_closed_when_capabilities_return_none, test_settings_get_fails_closed_when_capabilities_unresolvable, test_settings_get_fails_closed_when_capabilities_return_none, test_settings_export_fails_closed_when_capabilities_unresolvable, and test_settings_export_fails_closed_when_capabilities_return_none -- when capabilities_for_identity raises or returns None, safe_redact_evidence_refs() substitutes an empty capability set and fail_closed_redacted_refs() withholds every capability-gated ref.
acceptance_notes.never_widens_disclosure: models.redact_evidence_refs and _resolve_evidence_kind_and_capability were extended with default_kind, kind_map, authoritative URI scheme matching (e.g. audit://, incident://, alert://, postmortem://, signal://, persona://, metric://, policy://, approval://, artifact://, job://, strategy://, deployment://, runtime://, journal:// and alias schemes including paper-broker://, broker-evidence://, broker://, telemetry-event://, telemetry://, agora-signal://, signal-inference://, agora-journal://, policy-decision://, risk-policy://, risk-adjudication://, persona-policy://, approval-decision://, incident-report://, research-artifact://, strategy-spec://), and authoritative field kind handling to accurately classify production-shaped evidence references without widening disclosure; fail-closed behavior ensures unresolvable or None capabilities withhold all references. Authoritative URI schemes and field kinds are never downgraded by incidental path keywords or unrecognized envelope kinds. Route handlers and service methods that previously discarded identity or skipped redaction now route their payloads through these canonical redaction helpers.
acceptance_notes.no_duplicate_symbols_or_routers: The fail-closed capability-resolution wrapper and OODA redactors exist in exactly one place (models.py); governance/router.py delegates to safe_redact_evidence_refs. No new router, store, or fallback path was created; no symbol is defined twice.

acceptance_notes.bff_final_007_shape_match: Every withheld ref in this task's tests asserts redacted:true, required_capability, reason=="insufficient_capability", and each fixed surface's meta reports redacted_evidence_count -- produced entirely by models.redact_evidence_refs/RedactedEvidenceRef.
acceptance_notes.list_vs_detail_verified_separately: list_v5_interventions and its sibling detail route were audited and tested independently, surfacing the genuine structural difference between them (response_model-enforced schema on list route vs. raw pass-through on detail route).
